description: Yota LTE stick, Gemtek WLTUBA-107 (15a9:002d; the driver database names this model). A router inside the stick: cdc_ether and a DHCP address from it, no AT port; signal, cell and operator over its plain GET /status («Key=Value» lines: InterfaceType, DeviceName, 3GPP.RSRP/RSRQ/SINR/RSSI, 3GPP.MCC/MNC, 3GPP.CI, 3GPP.LAC, 3GPP.SPN, State), no login; its address the stick's gateway (10.0.0.1 on most). The IMSI is read only for the SIM's operator code. Reference only, not on our bench. Sources: another modem manager hilink.sh yota_metrics_json and its vendor list (15a9:*, 1076:8002), the working notes (status theirs: F), docs/HANDOFF.md 131; a router maker's firmware's list of supported USB modems (CDC Ethernet).
